content:
CIA report from 1952 titled Flying Saucers in Spain and North Africa.

#ufotwitter

Reports from foreign newspapers about sightings of strange aerial objects — often described as “flying saucers” — over various parts of Spain and North Africa in 1952.

1. Smoke-Trailing Object Over Barcelona (Spain)

📍 Barcelona and Badalona — 21 May 1952

Witness Valentin García saw a strange, fast-moving object about 2,000 m above ground, flying from the direction of Prat Airport.

It left a broad smoke trail and didn’t look like any known aircraft.

Unlike reported “flying saucers,” it did not flash or spin, but looked rocket-shaped, with two close smoke trails merging into one.

Colleagues saw the trail but not the object; it vanished and reappeared several kilometers away.

Many others called the newspaper reporting the sighting, and a photograph of the smoke trail was taken.

2. Unusual Object Over Tunisia

📍 Sousse, Tunisia — 3 June 1952

Many inhabitants observed a fast-moving object traveling west to east at high speed.

It emitted a pale green light across the sky

3. Flying Saucer Over Meknes (Morocco)

📍 Meknes, Morocco — 7 June 1952

Two witnesses saw a bright spot in the sky moving at very high speed, appearing faster than nearby T-33 military jets.

The object emitted a white smoke trail, made no sound, and traveled in a curved path (described as a parabola) before disappearing toward Ifrane in the south.

4. Flaming Disc Above Taourirt (Morocco)

📍 Taourirt, Morocco — 15 June 1952

Dock workers saw a disc of white flames with two circular strands and trailing smoke for ~30 seconds.

The fiery object seemed to move downward before vanishing rapidly.

5. Saucer Over Casablanca (Morocco)

📍 Casablanca, Morocco — 15 June 1952

Observed by Andre Assorin, a former pilot.

Sighted above Casablanca, though the local Meteorological Bureau reported no related unusual activity.

No detailed description was given in this short entry beyond confirmation of multiple sightings.
